For Springfield and Greater Springfield in Queensland, I found several law firms worth contacting if you're looking to keep upfront legal costs down. The strongest options are firms that advertise **free initial consultations, fixed-fee wills and estate planning, or flexible payment arrangements for family law**\.

One important distinction: a free first consultation doesn't mean the legal work itself is free, and a fixed fee for a will doesn't necessarily cover complex estate planning or disputes.

The distinction here is between a firm's published offer and a fee that still needs to be confirmed for your particular matter.

## What I would do first

1. **For separation, parenting or property settlement\:** contact Millwater Tyrrell Law and Stanford Legal first. Ask whether your matter qualifies for deferred payment and what the initial consultation covers.
2. **For a straightforward will\:** contact New Wave Law and Lavenia Law for written fixed-fee quotes.
3. **For both family law and estate planning\:** start with Stanford Legal, which advertises free initial discussions across both practice areas.

When comparing quotes, ask whether the price includes GST, document preparation, revisions, court filing fees (if relevant), and any additional work if the matter becomes contested.

One further option: Cancer Council Queensland lists **McNamara Law in Springfield** as a participating firm in its Free Will Service. Eligibility and the scope of the will service should be checked directly with the firm. [See the Free Will Service details](https://cancerqld.org.au/get-involved/legacy-giving/free-will-service/)\. [cancerqld.org.au](https://cancerqld.org.au/get-involved/legacy-giving/free-will-service/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One question that would help narrow this down\:** are you primarily looking for help with a separation or property settlement, making a will, or dealing with a deceased estate or disputed inheritance? The best affordable firm can differ considerably depending on which one applies.

The distinction here is between a firm's published offer and a fee that still needs to be confirmed for your particular matter.

## What I would do first

1. **For separation, parenting or property settlement\:** contact Millwater Tyrrell Law and Stanford Legal first. Ask whether your matter qualifies for deferred payment and what the initial consultation covers.
2. **For a straightforward will\:** contact New Wave Law and Lavenia Law for written fixed-fee quotes.
3. **For both family law and estate planning\:** start with Stanford Legal, which advertises free initial discussions across both practice areas.

When comparing quotes, ask whether the price includes GST, document preparation, revisions, court filing fees (if relevant), and any additional work if the matter becomes contested.

One further option: Cancer Council Queensland lists **McNamara Law in Springfield** as a participating firm in its Free Will Service. Eligibility and the scope of the will service should be checked directly with the firm. [See the Free Will Service details](https://cancerqld.org.au/get-involved/legacy-giving/free-will-service/)\.
